recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Do not remove BodyStructure or add redundant FHIR-11046 prose; future changes should proceed through current BodyStructure/bodySite harmonization issues rather than this historical DSTU2 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11046 asked to deprecate or remove BodySite as a stand-alone resource with a mandatory patient reference. The final Published disposition was Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the independent resource concept and remove the DSTU#3/STU note asking whether BodySite should remain independent.
initial_application: Commit 87a8e5f9c2ea21688115533d316c694f979a8ac1, "[#10586] and preapply [#11046]", deleted the BodySite dstu-note block from source/bodysite/bodysite-introduction.xml while preserving text that BodySite supports recording and tracking an anatomic location or structure outside the context of another resource.
additional_context: FHIR-7577 was the earlier common-structure/no-change request cited by the original disposition. FHIR-13396 later renamed BodySite to BodyStructure; the combined branch already contains an audit commit for that issue. Current fhir.ini actively builds bodystructure=BodyStructure and lists BodySite under removed resources. Current BodyStructure.patient is 0..1, so the original mandatory-patient concern is no longer present. Later R6 BodyStructure guidance work, including FHIR-54843, remains separate background and does not require reopening this DSTU2 disposition.
reconciliation: Created an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current build-scope BodyStructure narrative and examples already convey the accepted standalone tracking/reuse use cases, and the obsolete DSTU#3 note is absent from active source.
